cross_source_contradictions.description_detail: Frozen artifacts simultaneously state: (1) human-approved fixed prices (e.g. MENU_006 = 500 MAD, not a range); (2) disclaimer 'Prix indicatif FIXEO — tarif réel confirmé avec l'artisan'. These are contradictory: a fixed price is not indicative.
cross_source_contradictions.severity: P1 — philosophical/product contradiction requiring explicit human decision

options.A: FIXEO Reference Estimate — all prices indicative, artisan confirms actual price. Current disclaimer is correct. No guaranteed price.
options.B: FIXEO Standard Price — for eligible standardized services FIXEO guarantees the price. Client pays no more. Artisan receives FIXEO price - commission. Disclaimer becomes: 'Prix standard FIXEO pour les interventions éligibles — tarif garanti si conditions satisfaites.'
options.C: Hybrid — standardized fixed price for eligible services; indicative range for uncertain services; quote for custom. Disclaimer adapts by service type.
options.recommendation: Option C — most honest to current doctrine. All standardized approved services already have eligibility conditions baked in. Client experience: 'Ce service est au tarif fixe FIXEO de X MAD si les conditions suivantes sont réunies: [...]. Sinon, devis artisan.' This resolves the contradiction without overpromising.
